strings.validation.din6892_method_unknown: The selected DIN 6892 method does not exist.
strings.validation.din6892_calculation_invalid: The supplied data cannot evaluate the selected DIN 6892 method.
strings.validation.din6892_t1tr_invalid: The effective load-bearing depth t1tr could not be calculated.
strings.validation.K_lambda_required: Method B requires an explicit K_λ factor.
strings.validation.din6892_factor_placeholder: One or more licensed factors are still at the neutral value 1.0, so the result is provisional.
strings.validation.din6892_material_source_not_f: The FVA Method-B reformulation is being evaluated with material data other than the FVA catalogue it was calibrated on.
strings.validation.din6892_chamfer_s1_ignored: Equation 9 is evaluated with chamfer s1 = 0 although the key has one; t1tr and every derived torque are overstated.
strings.validation.din6892_friction_closure_inva: The equation 12 friction-closure factor could not be evaluated with the supplied slip torque.
strings.validation.din6892_length_ratio_exceeded: l_tr/d_w exceeds 1.3; beyond that the rear part of the key no longer transmits pressure.
strings.validation.din6892_length_fit_extrapolat: l_tr/d_w is outside the 0.5 to 1.3 range the length support factor was fitted for; the value is extrapolated.
strings.validation.fva_size_factor_out_of_domain: The shaft diameter is outside the data range the size factor K_d was fitted for.
strings.validation.fva_component_not_covered: The FVA reformulation is a shaft-keyway criterion, so this component still needs the current Method-B or Method-C check.
strings.validation.din6892_component_check_incom: A component was left out of the pressure check because its own material data are missing.
strings.validation.din6892_companion_invalid: A companion analytical method could not be evaluated and is reported separately.
strings.validation.din6892_bearing_depth_optimis: Equation 9 as transcribed gives a larger t1tr than the real shaft flank height, so every Method B and C torque is optimistic; use the CONSERVATIVE or GEOMETRIC policy to check it.
strings.validation.din6892_bearing_depth_policy_: The effective shaft bearing depth follows a policy other than the transcribed equation 9; both values are reported.
strings.validation.din6892_hub_bearing_depth_mis: Without t2tr the hub and the key are checked with the shaft depth t1tr; because DIN 6885 gives t2 < t1, the hub bearing area and its torque are overstated.
strings.validation.din6892_t2tr_invalid: The hub bearing depth t2tr could not be evaluated, so the hub falls back to t1tr and its result is optimistic.
strings.validation.din6892_load_reversal_derived: N_W was derived from the load ratio R: equation 3 counts load direction reversals, not load cycles.
strings.validation.din6892_load_reversal_unknown: The load direction is unknown, so every load cycle is counted as a reversal; supply R or N_W to remove this conservative assumption.
strings.validation.din6892_k_lambda_domain_inval: The K_lambda diagram domain could not be checked with the supplied data.
strings.validation.din6892_k_lambda_outside_diag: K_lambda is outside the 1.0 to 2.0 range of the DIN 6892 diagrams, so it cannot have been read from them.
strings.validation.din6892_k_lambda_qa_outside_d: Q_A = d_w/D is outside the 0.3 to 0.9 axis of the K_lambda diagrams; the reading is extrapolated.
strings.validation.din6892_k_lambda_length_outsi: l_tr/d_w is outside the 0.5 to 2 axis of the K_lambda diagrams; the reading is extrapolated.
strings.validation.din6892_method_c_clearance_ne: The top clearance g_c = t1 + t2 - h is negative: the key is taller than the two keyway depths together and equation 31 does not describe this joint.
strings.validation.din6892_method_c_sizing_inval: The Method C bearing length could not be sized from the required torque.
strings.validation.din6892_method_c_sizing_too_l: The required bearing length exceeds l_tr/d_w = 1.3, where the rear part of the key no longer transmits pressure; use more keys or another joint type.
strings.validation.din6892_method_c_not_conserva: Method C allows more torque than Method B: preliminary sizing has to stay on the safe side, so the Method B result governs.
strings.validation.fva_size_factor_transcription: Equation 29 does not meet the large-diameter plateau at 100 mm; the transcribed step is retained.
strings.validation.method_a_cycles_low: Research Method A requires at least 10 load cycles.
strings.validation.method_a_source_frame_missing: Method A requires an identified step and unloaded frame.
strings.validation.method_a_external_result_requ: Method A requires external FE/post-processing data.
strings.validation.method_a_postprocess_geometry: The geometry or U_PF changed after post-processing; process the evidence again.

strings.report.title: Automated shaft–hub–key model report
strings.report.abstract: This report was generated automatically from the machine-readable project and Abaqus audit JSON. Numerical values are not hardcoded in the document. The build verdict is {verdict}. Evidence badges distinguish normative data, research proposals, literature comparisons, internal screening and user overrides.
strings.report.provenance_text: The following SHA-256 values identify the exact engine, shared core and parameter file consumed by Abaqus. They can be compared with the release manifest's pre-build snapshot.
strings.report.scope_text: Derived DIN 6885-1 data is used only inside the implemented range 6 < d1 ≤ 500 mm. The analytical pressure calculation is CORE-SCREENING; it is not a complete DIN 6892 Method B verification. FVA 600 III content is labelled FVA-RESEARCH; the one-cycle NOJOB workflow is a pre-solve regression, not Method A. DIN/FVA source PDFs and protected figures are not embedded in the application or this report.
strings.report.section.mesh: Automatic mesh selection and quality gate
strings.report.mesh_text: The selected template is {template} (algorithm {algorithm}, mode {selection}). Its effective order/profile is {order}/{profile}. The global result is {status}, score {score}/100; hard gates passed: {hard}; policy gate passed: {passed}. The global score is the worst part score, not an average. ‘Best’ means the highest-ranked admissible candidate under this versioned policy; it is not a claim of universally perfect discretisation.
strings.report.mesh_ranking_text: After hard gates, candidates are ranked by status, score, hexahedral percentage, warnings, bulk aspect ratio and cost. The winning recipe is regenerated before assembly. Advancing-front reproduction permits at most 2% relative node/element change, 2 percentage points of hex coverage and 5 score points; exact equality is reported separately.
strings.report.deliverables_text: The project root contains separate input, generated, model, jobs, screenshots, reports and logs directories. project.json is the artifact manifest and provenance record.
strings.report.limitations: A successful build proves geometry/mesh generation, not structural suitability or regulatory acceptance.|Forms C–J and groove forms N2/N3 are blocked until their required geometry and dimensions are implemented.|DIN 743/FKM fatigue verification remains an external engineering task.|Any solved result requires mesh convergence, equilibrium and contact-path checks before it can be quoted.
strings.report.empty.no_provenance: No runtime source hashes were recorded.
strings.report.empty.no_quality_reasons: No quality-gate failure reasons were recorded.
strings.report.figure.caption: Model view: {name}
strings.report.compile.no_compiler_log: No latexmk or pdflatex executable was found on PATH. report.tex is retained without compilation.
